home.title: Singing Experience
home.subtitle: Train your voice with tools and games

pitchDetector.name: Pitch Detector
pitchDetector.description: Detect your singing pitch in real time. See the note, octave, and how in-tune you are.

doReMi.name: DO RE MI
doReMi.description: Sing through the scale — DO RE MI FA SO LA TI DO. Hold each note for a few seconds to advance.

tuner.name: Instrument Tuner
tuner.description: Pluck a string — see the note, cents deviation, and hear a chime when it's perfectly in tune.

toneDetector.name: Tone Detector
toneDetector.description: Detect multiple simultaneous tones in real time. Sing a harmony and see which notes are sounding.

scaleDetector.name: Chord & Scale Detector
scaleDetector.description: Sing or play a few notes and find out which chord or scale they make.

piano.name: Piano
piano.description: Play the piano keys and watch your voice land on the keyboard.

guitar.name: Guitar
guitar.description: Play the guitar strings and watch your voice land on the fretboard.

singTone.name: Sing Tone
singTone.description: A random tone is played — sing it back! Match different tones in a row to win.

pitchGame.name: Note Rush
pitchGame.description: Target notes scroll in — sing each one and hold it to score. Race the clock and hit as many as you can.

warmUp.name: Vocal Warm-Up
warmUp.description: Warm up your voice through a guided pitch sequence — hold each note to advance.

voiceRangeFinder.name: Voice Range Finder
voiceRangeFinder.description: Sing your lowest and highest notes to find your range. Every game can use it.

singingTools.name: Music Tools
singingTools.description: Find your pitch and get perfectly in tune.

singingGames.name: Singing Games
singingGames.description: Games to train your ear and voice.

singFly.name: Singfly
singFly.description: Sing to fly the bird through the gaps

graceKelly.name: Grace Kelly Challenge
graceKelly.description: Sing along to MIKA's "Grace Kelly". Pick a harmony part and follow the tones.

singTheKeys.name: Sing the Keys
singTheKeys.description: Notes fall onto the piano. Sing each one as it lands on its key.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: See every note on the staff and learn its name.

melodyWriter.name: Melody Writer
melodyWriter.description: Sing a tune and see it turn into sheet music.

circleOfFifths.name: Circle of Fifths
circleOfFifths.description: Sing DO, then SO, to hop from key to key. Light up all 12 keys of the circle of fifths.

voiceRecorder.name: Voice Recorder
voiceRecorder.description: Record your singing, play it back and see the notes you sang.

home.privacy: Your privacy is safe — this app runs 100% in your browser. Your voice is never sent anywhere. Recordings you make stay on your device.

pitchDetector.step1: Press Start and sing any note.
pitchDetector.step2: The big letter is your note. The bar next to it shows if you're a bit sharp or flat.
pitchDetector.step3: Open the Focus tab to hold one note and earn a level.

warmUp.step1: Pick your voice and a pattern, then press Start.
warmUp.step2: Listen to the phrase, then sing it back.
warmUp.step3: Each round moves up a semitone. Stop when it feels too high.

voiceRangeFinder.step1: Press Find my range. Hold your lowest note until the bar fills, press Done, then do the same going up.
voiceRangeFinder.step2: Press Use this to save it as My range — or pick the notes yourself.
voiceRangeFinder.step3: Open the Explore tab and turn on See my voice. The voices that can sing your note light up.

notes.step1: Look at the staff to see where each note sits.
notes.step2: Press Start on the Listen tab to hear the notes one by one.
notes.step3: Use the Overview tab to see every note at once.

piano.step2: Sing, and watch your voice light up the key you're on.
piano.step3: Pick a key and scale to highlight the notes that fit.

guitar.step1: Tap or swipe the strings to play. The small number tells the two E's apart: E2 is the thick, deep string, E4 the thin, high one.
guitar.step2: Sing, and watch your voice land on the fretboard.
guitar.step3: Pick a key and scale to highlight the notes that fit.

scaleDetector.step1: Sing or play a few different notes.
scaleDetector.step2: Watch which scales or chords fit your notes.
scaleDetector.step3: Press Start over to try new notes.

melodyWriter.step1: Pick a tempo and press Record.
melodyWriter.step3: Watch your tune turn into notes on the staff.

toneDetector.step2: Sing, hum or play several notes at once.
toneDetector.step3: Every tone you make shows up on screen.

tuner.step1: Pick your instrument and tuning, then press Start.
tuner.step2: Pluck one string and let it ring. The small number tells the two E's apart: E2 is the thick, deep string, E4 the thin, high one.
tuner.step3: Turn the peg until the needle sits in the middle and you hear a chime.

singTone.step1: Press Play to hear a tone.
singTone.step2: Sing the same tone back and hold it.
singTone.step3: Match all the tones to win.

doReMi.step1: Pick your start tone and press Start.
doReMi.step2: Sing the note shown and hold it until it moves on.
doReMi.step3: Get all the way up the scale to finish.

singTheKeys.step1: Pick a song and press Start.
singTheKeys.step3: Sing each note as it lands on its key.

graceKelly.step2: Press Start and follow the tones as the song plays.
graceKelly.step3: Try the Harmony tab to hear the parts together.

singFly.step2: Sing higher to fly up, lower to fly down.
singFly.step3: Fly through the gaps to score.

pitchGame.step2: Sing each note as it scrolls in and hold it to score.
pitchGame.step3: Hit as many notes as you can before time runs out.

circleOfFifths.step2: Sing DO, then SO, to hop to the next key.
circleOfFifths.step3: Light up all 12 keys to finish.

singingTools.step1: Pick a tool to open it.
singingTools.step2: Most tools listen through your microphone. Allow it when your browser asks.
singingTools.step3: Inside each tool, tap How it works to see what everything means.

singingGames.step2: Games listen to you sing, so allow the microphone when your browser asks.
singingGames.step3: Inside each game, tap How it works for the rules.

home.step1: Pick a tool or a game to open it.
home.step2: Allow the microphone when your browser asks. Without it, the programs can't hear you sing.
home.step3: New here? Try the first steps: warm up, find your range, then sing a tone.

voiceRecorder.step1: Press Record and sing. The moving line shows the mic can hear you.
voiceRecorder.step2: Press Stop, then play your recording or download it.
voiceRecorder.step3: Tap "See what you sang" to see your notes and how it sounds.

note.name: Note
note.description: The letter name of the sound you sing, like C, D or E.

octave.name: Octave
octave.description: The small number after a note. A bigger number means a higher sound.

sharpFlat.name: Sharp ♯ and flat ♭
sharpFlat.description: Sharp means higher, flat means lower. Singing a bit sharp means you're a little too high.

cents.name: Cents
cents.description: How far you are from the exact note. 100 cents is one piano key. Closer to 0 is better.

semitone.name: Semitone
semitone.description: The smallest step in music: from one piano key to the very next one.

hz.name: Hz
hz.description: How fast the sound shakes. More Hz means a higher sound.

clarity.name: Clarity
clarity.description: How clean and steady your sound is. Higher is easier to read.

voiceParts.name: Soprano to Bass
voiceParts.description: Names for voices from high to low: Soprano, Mezzo-Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Baritone, Bass.

voiceRange.name: Voice range
voiceRange.description: The notes from your lowest to your highest. Pick one that feels comfy.

myRange.name: My range
myRange.description: The notes from your lowest to your highest. Every game can use it.

songRange.name: Song range
songRange.description: The song's lowest to highest notes. Pick one that feels comfy.

yourMelody.name: Your melody
yourMelody.description: The line is your voice. The blocks are the notes we heard.

notesUsed.name: Notes you used
notesUsed.description: The notes you sang and how long you sang each one.

likelyKey.name: Likely key
likelyKey.description: The key your notes fit best. It's a guess. Press "Play scale" to hear it.

soundProfile.name: What it sounds like
soundProfile.description: Each slider shows which word fits your singing better.

rangeUsed.name: Range used
rangeUsed.description: Your lowest to highest notes, leaving out quick slips. The map's scale can reach a bit further.

howSteady.name: How steady it was
howSteady.description: How well you held your notes and stayed in key, not how good your voice is.

solfege.name: DO RE MI
solfege.description: Names for the notes of a scale: DO RE MI FA SO LA TI DO.

scale.name: Scale
scale.description: A set of notes that sound good together, sung in order.

key.name: Key
key.description: The home note a song is built around, like C major.

chord.name: Chord
chord.description: Three or more notes that sound good together.

harmony.name: Harmony
harmony.description: Different notes sung at the same time that fit together.

staff.name: Staff
staff.description: The five lines notes sit on. The higher on the lines, the higher the note.

bpm.name: BPM
bpm.description: Beats per minute: how fast the music goes.

recordingQuality.name: Standard or Studio
recordingQuality.description: Standard sounds clear and is right for almost every recording. Studio keeps more detail when you sing very softly, but the file is 1.5 times bigger.

smallFile.name: Small file
smallFile.description: A smaller copy of your recording, about 1 MB a minute, that is easy to send in a message. Download keeps the full quality.

voiceRecorder.hint:
Sing without backing music. You can record up to {seconds} seconds.
Your recording stays on this device until you clear it or record again.
voiceRecorder.smallFileFailed: Failed to make a small file. You can still download the full one.

stopped.limit: That's the longest recording that fits, so it stopped here.
stopped.interrupted: Recording stopped early, but we kept what you sang.

analysis.failed: Failed to read the recording. You can still play and download it.
analysis.empty: We couldn't hear any clear notes in this recording.

warnings.tooQuiet: This recording is very quiet. Move closer to the mic.
warnings.clipped: Some parts were too loud and got cut off. Move back from the mic a little.
warnings.unclear: It's hard to hear a clear tune. Talking or backing music can cause this.

melody.title: Your melody
melody.ariaLabel: Map of the notes you sang over time
melody.hint: Tap the map to jump to that moment. Green blocks are in tune, yellow to red are sharp, blue are flat.

notes.title: Notes you used
notes.sungHint: Coloured notes are the ones you sang.

profile.title: What it sounds like
profile.guess: A fun guess from pitch and rhythm, not a judgement.

rating.title: How steady it was
rating.tooShort: Sing a few different notes for at least {seconds} seconds to get a rating.
rating.notEnoughSinging: Clear singing heard: {heard} of {seconds} seconds. Sing a bit longer to get a rating. Pauses and breaths don't count.
rating.note: This looks at how steady your notes are, not how good your voice is.

tips.centring: Try humming a note first, then land right in the middle of it.
tips.steadiness: Take a deeper breath so long notes stay steady.
tips.key: Listen back for notes that wander away from the tune, then sing just those again.

voiceRecorder.noSoundYet: We can't hear you yet. Check your mic and sing a little.
